title: Shinonome Akito — Committed Actor〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (With Soda out, I have to start doing my own stunts...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm not nearly as good as him, but I've gotta do what I can.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito, the cast's all here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's start discussing the stunts for the final showdown. Mind starting us off with any thoughts you have?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The toughest part of this scene is probably when you have to take on all three goons and deal with them one after another...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have some ideas of how we're gonna use drones and your cape to make your stunts look flashier...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Yeah, but isn't there anything else we can do to make this scene feel more dynamic...?

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
These kinds of scenes are tricky...
The movements are pretty complicated, so everyone's gotta time everything right or it's gonna look really bad...

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Actually, I've already told Kusanagi and the camera crew that we might have to do multiple takes before we can get it right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see... It does sound pretty hard.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: If we want to make things easier, we could reduce the number of enemies or have him fight each of them one at a time instead...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, the scene would have less impact if we did that. So, let's go with our current plan for the fight...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's only one scene, so I can just focus on it and practice until my body knows it by heart.

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Okay, got it...!
We'll practice until you get it perfect!

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Get ready for round two, stunt team!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we got this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now, what else is there...?
Two hours later

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm exhausted!
Still, thank goodness we have a plan now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. Thanks for staying so late to discuss this, everyone. Let's start heading home.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Starting tomorrow, the camera crew and the stunt team will practice this together.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
*Nod*
See you then!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right as we're supposed to head home. Shall we, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Shinonome, let's walk back together for part of the way!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, you guys go on ahead...
I'm gonna stay a bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
You are?
Then, see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I need to go over what we did just now, at least. But I can't stay for long since all the students are supposed to leave now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, you're still here...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was just wondering what you were doing staying back by yourself. You seem really motivated.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I am a little...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We've come this far, so I don't wanna stumble here, you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I don't want this film to cause someone to feel any regret. Not after all the hard work we put into it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, let's put our heads together and make sure we all come out of this with no regrets...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's come up with the best possible solution we can for this situation. A solution that doesn't involve cutting corners.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (After I heard that speech...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I kinda get why you feel so motivated, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kusanagi did give a pretty good speech back there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, she did...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I don't want Soda and the others' hard work to go to waste.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Me neither.
I wanna make it so we're all smiling at the end.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Me too.
So, let's keep doing what we can until we call it a wrap.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!
